units: occupied target-product common-grid centroid cell-days per complete UTC month
cohorts: Two distinct explicit standard source/version cohorts; no NRT, relabelling or chained factor.
count_basis: Union of authentic stored exact-cohort observations; request-backed exports establish UTC completeness rather than exclusive batch ownership. Same-version stored snapshots may be combined; latest-single-export authentication is not claimed.
selection: Training-only nested leave-one-year-out ratio selection; fixed identity, annual and calendar-month ratios. Annual fallback when monthly source denominator<30.
chronology: Forward:train<Y-2,calY-2/Y-1,testY. Backward:train>Y+2,calY+1/Y+2,testY; historical retrospective estimation only.
interval: Nominal90%,absolute log1p residual order statistic ceil((n+1)*.9), no temporal/conditional guarantee. Fixed baselines calibrated on same dates.

admission_rules.authority: Proposed project research gates, not NASA standards. Signed human protocol/conclusion and opportunity-change evidence separately required.

ai_audit_scope: Direct source/version identity, frozen sensor notices, date completeness and raw-cell recount.
Training/calibration/test partitions disjoint within each fold. Backward evaluation uses later records explicitly.
No qualified transfer from AI-only mode, smoothness, factor chaining or manual passed booleans.
Unmeasured opportunity changes, stored-snapshot heterogeneity and numerical transport remain limitations.
